fullContentHtml:
SSC JHT Option Cum Preference Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Option Cum Preference Form for the post of Junior Hindi Translator, Hindi Translator, Senior Translator & Hindi Pradhyapak CHT. This recruitment was released for 437 posts. Applications for the SSC JHT Recruitment 2025 were accepted from June 05, 2025, to June 26, 2025. The paper II examination is going to be conducted on 14 December 2025. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their Paper-II Result 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 05 June 2025
  • Last Date : 26 June 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 27 June 2025
  • Correction Date : 01-02 July 2025
  • Exam Date : 12 August 2025
  • Exam City Details : 05 August 2025
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Answer Key : 04 September 2025
  • Result : 04 November 2025
  • CHTE Paper-II Exam Date : 14 December 2025
  • Exam City Details : 04 December 2025
  • Paper-II Admit Card : 12 December 2025
  • Paper-I Marks & Final Answer Key : 30 December 2025
  • Paper-II Result : 04 June 2026
  • Option Cum Preference Form : 08 – 11 September 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST, Female : Rs. 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
